title: 幻想水滸伝
sources: Headless replay of the opening from power-on (first room, corridor, audience with the emperor, the first choice, the menu): about 150 frames compared with the layout's reading
The game's font in video memory, read glyph by glyph; checked against sentences in the system text on the disc and in memory, and against a reference 12-pixel font
notes: One 16-bit table for the whole game (tables/ps1/SLPS-00097.tbl): the code is the glyph's place in the font. The dialogue is packed on the disc and unpacked in memory; the system text is on the disc as plain codes. 21 of the kanji were never seen in a sentence (here or in Gensou Suikoden II, which shares most of the font), so one or two may be wrong. Not reached in the replay: talking to townspeople, shops, battles, the war and duel screens. Cursor marks, wait marks and item icons (0x35-0x3B, 0xF2-0xF7) are not mapped.
